contrast.standard: WCAG AA contrast targets for enabled content and controls
contrast.scope: Source-token measurements for enabled normal, hover, pressed, selected, focus, error and success states. Disabled controls are excluded from these contrast requirements. Decorative dividers/artwork are not interactive boundaries.
contrast.stateMeaning: Selected steps, export segments and language choices add a 1px teal outline; errors and completion retain explicit text and distinct icons.
contrast.limits: Contrast measurements do not establish full WCAG conformance or verify screen-reader behavior.

narrative.overview: The existing product uses a clean, simple, modern workspace across supported platforms. Flat cool surfaces, visible file mappings, restrained teal actions and embedded Rust UI fonts support readable packaging and extraction. The standalone HTML wizard shares palette and shapes with semantic controls and system typography.
keyCharacteristics: Centered bounded workspace and responsive mapping rows.
Embedded Inter regular/semibold and retained CJK fallback for shared Rust UI.
Explicit labels, visible focus and persistent status.

rules.name: Readable enabled states
rules.body: Maintain at least 4.5:1 normal-text contrast and 3:1 interactive-boundary/focus contrast. Preserve selected outlines and textual/icon state cues.

dos: Do reuse shared Rust tokens and components.
Do distinguish source files from package paths.
Do preserve EN/DE copy, CJK fallback, focus and cancellation.
Do preserve semantic HTML download/disclosure and user-provided icons.
Do retain AA contrast targets and update the source-token audit when changing palette values.
donts: Don't introduce a replacement brand identity.
Don't retain stale structure previews after mapping changes.
Don't equate HTML system fonts or focus widths with Rust defaults.
